subject: Feedback scrub + prioritization for Kevin Park (Backend SWE)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@talentco.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Feedback scrub + prioritization for Kevin Park (Backend SWE)

Team —

Thanks again for interviewing Kevin last week. We're getting close to a decision but I want to run a quick feedback scrub before we lock a hire/no-hire. Goal: surface any major disagreements on safety/scale fit and agree on next steps (hire, second-round focused task, or pause).

Please do two small things by EOD today:
- Drop your numeric score (1-5) in the attached scorecard and add 1-2 bullet rationale.
- Flag any must-clarify concerns (security, past infra ownership, or performance under load).

I captured my quick notes in the doc (link below). If you think a 15-min sync is required to resolve conflicting signals, say so in your reply.

Attachments: kevin_park_scorecard.xlsx, interview-notes-08-27.pdf
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Jk-feedback-scrub

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Staff SWE Hiring Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feedback scrub + prioritization for Kevin Park (Backend SWE)

Jordan —

Score (overall): 4/5
Rationale: Strong systems fundamentals, good take on KV cache invalidation and prefix caching tradeoffs. Slight hesitation on prior infra scale — his examples were at mid-size scale (10s of machines) not 100s, but he reasoned well about distributed tracing and fallbacks.

Must-clarify: ownership of CI/CD for model runtime (did he personally own rollout safety hooks?) — would like a quick follow-up question.

No need for a wider sync from my side unless Aditya sees major infra gaps.

—Laura
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feedback scrub + prioritization for Kevin Park (Backend SWE)

Score: 3/5
Quick notes:
- Pros: Clear on latency vs. cost tradeoffs, good instincts about KV cache invalidation windows.
- Cons: Example set felt academic; limited hands-on ownership of production alerting / SLO ops. When pressed he deferred to "team" ownership several times.

I'm leaning toward: move to a targeted follow-up interview that focuses on SLOs, on-call incidents, and incident postmortems (30-45min). If he can show concrete incident ownership, I can move to a 4.

If others disagree and are happy to greenlight, I'm OK deferring to hiring manager judgment.

-Aditya
Sr Engineering Manager, Reliability
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 13:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feedback scrub + prioritization for Kevin Park (Backend SWE)

Quick submit — score 4/5.
Bullets:
- Very strong debugging examples; walked through a cache stampede fix end-to-end.
- Culture fit seemed good; asked good clarifying questions about tradeoffs.
- No glaring security flags.

I agree with Aditya that a focused ops SLO conversation would close the gap. I'm available Wed afternoon if we want to schedule the follow-up.

-Tessa

Thanks all — helpful pattern here: majority leaning hire but Aditya wants a narrow ops check. Proposed plan:
1) Ask TalentCo to run a 30-min ops-focused panel with Aditya + Laura (no more than two interviewers).
2) If Kevin shows direct incident ownership, proceed to offer; if not, close as pass.
3) Tessa, can you coordinate scheduling for Wed 08/01 or Thu 09/02? (I kept the candidate's timezone PDT in mind)

Simon — can you confirm Kevin's availability for a 30-minute slot this week? If TalentCo prefers to prep him, please share the focus areas (SLOs, incident postmortem, pager ownership).

Jordan
